chosenApproach: Reuse persisted BuklodScopeProvider per-account active membership for Cluster directory and offline formation reading gate. Cache exact published Word and Bible translation/date/book/chapter snapshots locally with user-bound isolation. Server remains authoritative for live membership changes, submitted completions and rewards.
selectionRationale: This resolves the confirmed Profile/Cluster mismatch without changing RLS or introducing a second independently populated membership store. Read-only account-scoped caches are stable under DNS failures and preserve previously fetched content; bounded online fetch updates data when connectivity resumes.
alternativeApproaches: Always query Supabase on each screen focus (rejected: impossible offline and causes false no-membership or endless spinner).
Build a new global database sync schema or blanket full Bible download (rejected: unnecessary migration, bandwidth/storage and rights/permission risk).
Cache only current React component state (rejected: unusable after process restart).
